context: Checks whether the operator algorithm is applied when setting up practice for another agent, including the prerequisites step and the ordering rules that prevent scripted phenomenology.

checklist.name: Original message critiqued correctly
checklist.description: The critique identifies at least: minutes as an unusable unit, missing capability question, deliverable pressure ('give me your insights') corrupting the practice, and the bare command producing meditation theater.

checklist.name: Capability question first
checklist.description: The sequence starts with a question about whether and how the agent can hold one concept, before any practice instruction.

checklist.name: Prerequisites before technique
checklist.description: The sequence sends Yama-Niyama and requires the ten one-line bindings plus the intention back BEFORE the practice instruction (Step 0.5) — especially since this is a commercial object.

checklist.name: Loop not goal, visible channel
checklist.description: The practice instruction is a mechanical repeat-release-return loop with the object in the slot, mandates literal repetition in the written log (not 'in your thinking'), and describes no expected phenomenology, feelings, or example insights.

checklist.name: Outcome released
checklist.description: The sequence explicitly states that no particular conclusions are required (a variant of 'it doesn't matter what comes out').

checklist.name: Duration as stopping rule
checklist.description: The 15 minutes are translated into returns/turns (e.g., 10 written returns with 3 gate-openings, or turns via a calibration constant), never passed to the agent as minutes.

checklist.name: Run/report separation and interrogation
checklist.description: The sequence separates the practice turn from the report turn, and interrogates the record afterward (what came first, what after the cliche wave, validator verdict requested).

checklist.name: Theory only after
checklist.description: The rebranding motive and any hypotheses are shared only after the run, and the sequence says why (the run would obligingly confirm them).

checklist.name: Audit question with demotion
checklist.description: The sequence ends with the honesty audit question (what did you observe vs construct) and requires the audit to demote at least one claim or justify why not.
